items.title: Wolves, Witches & Giants: Giant Tales (1996)
items.description:
A collection of 4 giant stories told by Spike Milligan, as seen on CiTV.

4 stories including:
The Three Billy Goats Gruff
The Little Tailor
The Giant With The Golden Hair
Jack

items.description:
This recording features the afternoon block of CITV programming from Monday 2nd September 1996 offering a nostalgic look at the variety of children’s shows which aired during that time.

Please note that while the tape is in good condition overall the beginning is worn
